"""Separate reviewer probe; writes only new scratch evidence, never candidate files."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(r"C:\Users\manem\Desktop\QASCP\public-review-20261125")
SCRIPT = ROOT / "scripts/verify_checkout_auth.py"
OUT = Path(__file__).with_suffix(".json")
MARKER = "QASCP-NONSECRET-PASS2-INDEPENDENT-MARKER"
ENV = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_")}
ENV.update(GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull,
           PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1")
results = []


def case(name, scope=None, key=None, directive=None, malformed=False,
         clean_extension=False, missing=False, nonrepo=False):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
        base = Path(temporary)
        repo = base / "repo"
        repo.mkdir()

        def git(*args):
            return subprocess.run(["git", *args], cwd=repo, env=ENV,
                                  capture_output=True, check=True)

        git("init", "--quiet")
        if scope == "--worktree" or clean_extension:
            git("config", "--local", "extensions.worktreeConfig", "true")
        if clean_extension:
            git("config", "--worktree", "user.name", "Synthetic Reviewer")
        if directive:
            included = base / "included-config"
            if not missing:
                git("config", "--file", str(included), key, MARKER)
            git("config", scope, directive, str(included))
        elif key:
            git("config", scope, key, MARKER)
        effective_present = None
        if key and not missing:
            effective = git("config", "--show-scope", "--includes", "--name-only", "--list")
            effective_present = key.lower().encode() in effective.stdout.lower()
        if malformed:
            filename = "config.worktree" if scope == "--worktree" else "config"
            (repo / ".git" / filename).write_text("[" + MARKER, encoding="utf-8")
        cwd = base if nonrepo else repo
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", str(SCRIPT)], cwd=cwd,
                                env=ENV, capture_output=True, timeout=30)
        expected = 1 if key or directive or malformed or nonrepo else 0
        exposed = MARKER.encode() in result.stdout + result.stderr
        record = {"case": name, "scope": scope, "key": key,
                  "expected_exit": expected, "actual_exit": result.returncode,
                  "effective_key_present": effective_present,
                  "marker_exposed": exposed,
                  "stdout": result.stdout.decode("utf-8"),
                  "stderr": result.stderr.decode("utf-8")}
        record["passed"] = (result.returncode == expected and not exposed
                            and effective_present is not False)
        results.append(record)


case("clean normal repository")
case("clean enabled worktree scope", clean_extension=True)
keys = ("credential.helper", "credential.https://example.invalid.helper",
        "http.extraheader", "http.https://example.invalid/.extraheader", "core.sshCommand")
for scope in ("--local", "--worktree"):
    for key in keys:
        case("direct " + scope + " " + key, scope=scope, key=key)
    for directive in ("include.path", "includeIf.gitdir:**/repo/.git.path"):
        for key in ("credential.helper", "http.extraheader", "core.sshCommand"):
            case("included " + scope + " " + directive + " " + key,
                 scope=scope, key=key, directive=directive)
    case("malformed " + scope, scope=scope, malformed=True)
case("missing worktree include", scope="--worktree", directive="include.path", missing=True)
case("inactive worktree conditional include", scope="--worktree",
     directive="includeIf.gitdir:/qas-pass2-never-match/.path", missing=True)
case("nonrepository inspection", nonrepo=True)
payload = {"candidate_sha": "b5702fd09083eb01b54e65cc85e72e50fdc10f55",
           "tree_sha": "34459658543448ea3bcbbdcd22c603ea85305e70",
           "reviewer": "/root/p1_security_arch_review",
           "script_sha256": hashlib.sha256(SCRIPT.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
           "python": sys.version,
           "git": subprocess.run(["git", "--version"], capture_output=True,
                                 text=True, check=True).stdout.strip(),
           "cases": results}
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"cases": len(results), "passed": sum(r["passed"] for r in results),
                  "marker_exposures": sum(r["marker_exposed"] for r in results),
                  "evidence": str(OUT)}))
raise SystemExit(0 if all(r["passed"] for r in results) else 1)
